items.title: AI Has Completely Rewritten the Rules of the Stock Market
items.summary: AI on/AI off is now driving the stock market.  Rocky Fishman at Asym Research points out that of the 11 sectors that make up the  five have a zero or negative correlation with the index over the past five months, including healthcare and real estate.  If I told you the  exchange-traded fund is up 1.2% this week—it is—you wouldn’t be any closer to knowing that the S&P 500 is falling 0.2%, which it is.

items.title: CMCSA Q2 Deep Dive: Wireless Growth and Media Strength Offset Broadband Headwinds
items.summary: Telecommunications and media company Comcast (NASDAQ:CMCSA) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 2.7% year on year to $29.57 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.04 per share was 7.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
